coordinateProjection.basis: Babylon handedness conversion independently observed in runtime task placement captures
coordinateProjection.mapDirection: CHRD/DIRT is retained separately; it is a native map-wide heading offset, not a map-local position transform

evidenceBoundary: Typed entries and uniquely serialized CHRS Character AKIR placements are reported separately. AKIR is accepted as the authored default player placement because maps containing both representations have bit-exact Entry 0 agreement. Partial-body records such as YKUR and maps with no AKIR remain unresolved. Each exact placement includes the deterministic Babylon handedness projection used by runtime model placements. CHRD/DIRT is decoded with the native 0x0c0f26e0 conversion and retained separately.
